resolver.command: uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra tooling --python-version 3.13.11 --python-platform aarch64-apple-darwin --generate-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-annotate

scopeLimits: Every Requires-Dist line is evaluated for the recorded target marker environment and each requested extra context; uv performs target-platform resolution. Kernel-specific marker values are not claimed.
License metadata and bundled license-file digests are descriptive, not legal compatibility decisions.
Closure includes only optional mcp==2.3.0 tooling dependency closure, not core/build/development dependencies.
Wheel hashes identify exact private wheelhouse files; text lock hashes permit published artifact variants for the selected versions.
